Hello Studio 360 Photography team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for wedding photographers in Chennai. I was looking at studio360photography.com this week. Your site already opens strong on a phone, with full-screen photos and a clear “book a shoot” button, and the haldi shot with marigolds flying is a lovely first impression.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:

See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/studio-360-photography/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. Families open on a laughing bride in jasmine garlands, then scroll through framed moments from a pre-wedding by the sea to a maternity shoot and a toddler with a rose, before the numbers, the founder's story and a date button.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a candid wedding photographer in Porur”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now studio360photography.com has a few of the basics, but not the full set these tools look for. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • This new website, live on your own domain (studio360photography.com)
  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your services, cities covered, studio address, studio hours and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “check my date” button that sends the shoot date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so couples and young families searching for candid wedding photographers in Porur can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on studio360photography.com
